title: Why in the World Is Carvana Buying Brick-and-Mortar Dealerships?!
title_zh: Carvana 到底为何要收购实体经销商？！
summary: Not only is it a strange development for Carvana to buy dealerships, the used-car retailer might be doing it for a different reason than you think.
summary_zh: Carvana 收购经销商不仅是一个奇怪的发展，而且二手车零售商这样做的原因可能与你想象的不同。

title: Apple’s MotionVFX Deal Deepens Creator Studio And Services Ecosystem
title_zh: Apple 的 MotionVFX 交易深化了创作者工作室和服务生态系统
summary: Apple has acquired MotionVFX, a developer of plug ins and tools for Final Cut Pro, in a move to deepen its creative software offering. The deal is aimed at building out the Creator Studio bundle and reinforcing Apple's position with professional content creators.
summary_zh: Apple 收购了 Final Cut Pro 插件和工具开发商 MotionVFX，以深化其创意软件产品。该交易旨在打造 Creator Studio 捆绑包并巩固苹果在专业内容创作者中的地位。

title: Warner Bros. CEO set to receive big payday from Paramount deal
title_zh: 华纳兄弟首席执行官将从派拉蒙交易中获得巨额报酬
summary: Warner Bros. (WBD) CEO David Zaslav could receive up to $887 million from the company's Paramount (PSKY) deal. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma outline the details in the video above.
summary_zh: 华纳兄弟 (WBD) 首席执行官戴维·扎斯拉夫 (David Zaslav) 可能会从该公司与派拉蒙 (PSKY) 的交易中获得高达 8.87 亿美元的收益。雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者杰克·康利和雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛在上面的视频中概述了详细信息。

title: Is KKR’s (KKR) Deal Juggling Amid Liquidity Strains Reframing Its Private Markets Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 在流动性紧张的情况下进行的交易是否正在重新制定其私募市场策略？
summary: In recent days, KKR has reportedly joined the bidding for Pacific Equity Partners-owned UP Education, which could fetch more than A$1.00 billion, while also exploring a potential sale of liquid-cooling provider CoolIT Systems in a deal that may exceed US$3.00 billion.
summary_zh: 据报道，最近几天，KKR 加入了对 Pacific Equity Partners 旗下的 UP Education 的竞购，该交易的售价可能超过 10 亿澳元，同时还在探索出售液冷供应商 CoolIT Systems 的可能性，交易金额可能超过 30 亿美元。
